title: Cardinal Caracciolo (Milan) to Charles V, 14 November 1537 (AGS Estado leg. 1184 fol. 110, DECODE R9966)

steps.what: Tomokiyo spanish2C copy grepped for R9966: readable with Luo's Lu.38; first four lines given.
DECODE R9966 record and 4 images fetched with the shared cookie; order mapped to AGS 0408-0411.
Luo 2021 thesis downloaded from RODERIC; Cifrario 38 table (p. 657) read.
Luo PDF searched for leg. 1184 and the names in the cipher: letter not edited.
11 cipher lines of AGS 0409 deciphered line by line with Cifrario 38 unchanged; Tomokiyo's lines confirmed with two corrections; lines 5-11 read with scattered gaps.
Retry: gap spots re-read at 4x with autocontrast; hooked 9 = e homophone (line 4), dotted # = null (line 5); others unchanged.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt, cipher tokens, [..] counted as unread

gaps.item: cancelled line at the top of f. 111r

outcome.notes: Published key read the letter unchanged; Tomokiyo had read four lines; the rest read here with gaps.

prior.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana 'Spanish ciphers during the reign of Charles V' (Luo update): names Lu.38 and reads the first four lines

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
